notes.title: Thank You for an Amazing Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

I just wanted to take a moment to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who played the Jolly Land Adventure demo during Steam Next Fest!

Seeing so many of you download the game and add it to your wishlists truly means the world to me. Your support has been incredibly encouraging — and it’s helping fuel my motivation as I continue working toward release.

If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist Jolly Land Adventure! It’s the best way to stay up to date as I head toward launch.

You can also give me feedback by filling out [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdPeV-JYOrUAKM0C0t6mUHZdgLQ1da5yYZpTWGkJehfprAIQg/viewform"]this form[/url]

Thank You.[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 New Trailer, Episode 2 Sneak Peek, and Demo Polish! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've just dropped a brand new trailer for Jolly Land Adventure! This one gives you a sneak peek at some of the levels from Episode 2, along with a look at the improved visuals in Episode 1. It’s a fun glimpse at how things are shaping up, and I'm happy to finally show more of what’s coming next!

Check out the trailer on the store page! 🎥

In addition, There has been some minor improvements and polish to the demo — small tweaks here and there to make things smoother and more enjoyable for new and returning players alike. If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now’s a great time to jump in!

Thanks so much for your support, and stay tuned — there’s more to come soon!

notes.title: Demo Updated + Episode 2 Progress!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579945/4f76c1ca3c3c41282047cb593e438b3de8712c22.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone! I’ve pushed a fresh update to the Jolly Land Adventure demo on all platforms!

[h1]🆕 What's New in the Demo[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Brighter, more colorful visuals ✨
[*]     Option to automatically jump into a (random) next level 🎲
[*]     New feedback feature in the "Extras" menu — I'd love to hear your thoughts! 📝
[*]     Plus lots of small tweaks and polish to improve the overall experience 💫
[/list]
[h1]🌟 Episode 2 Progress[/h1]
All the levels for Episode 2 are now drafted and playable! I’ve added new screenshots to the store page and included one from Episode 2 right here in this post so you can get a quick look at what's coming next! 📸

Thanks for playing, and I hope you enjoy the updated demo! 💛
